name: r-commander-play
description: Run R code with visible output from a green play button, and use the R Commander menus (File, Data, Statistics, Graphs, Models, Distributions...) from the editor, in English or Spanish.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Running R code requires a trusted workspace.

rCommanderPlay.skipHelp.description: Skip standalone ?, ??, help() and help.search() commands when using the green play button.

rCommanderPlay.skipCommands.description: Standalone function calls to skip with the green play button, for example fix, View, or utils::example. Calls inside functions or other expressions are kept.

rCommanderPlay.limitOutput.description: Show a short preview of long vectors, matrices and data frames with the green play button. Hidden entries remain in memory. Turn off to use the R session's normal printing limits.

rCommanderPlay.maxOutputItems.description: Maximum printed entries per result when Limit Long Output is enabled. R reports the omitted entries or rows. Applies to print methods that respect max.print.

enumDescriptions: Follow the VS Code display language
rCommanderPlay.language.description: Language of the R Commander dialogs. Menu labels follow the VS Code display language (use "R Commander: Set Language" to switch them too).

rCommanderPlay.loadRcmdrFunctions.description: Make the functions of R Commander and its plug-ins (Recode, Hist, calcular_frecuencia...) available in the R session before running code, without opening the R Commander window.

rCommanderPlay.rcmdrPlugins.description: R Commander plug-ins to load, for example RcmdrPlugin.TeachStat. Empty loads every installed RcmdrPlugin.* package.

enumDescriptions: One window with every option at once, like R Commander
One question at a time in the top bar
rCommanderPlay.dialogStyle.description: How the R Commander menus ask for their options.

enumDescriptions: Run the generated R code in the R terminal
Only insert the generated code at the end of the R script
Insert it in the script and run it
rCommanderPlay.menuAction.description: What the R Commander menus do with the R code they generate.
